hooks.name: Write probes for new criteria
hooks.description: When a requirements doc is saved, asks Kiro to add a Specter probe or monitor line to every acceptance criterion that doesn't have one.

action.prompt: A requirements document was just saved. For every acceptance criterion that has no indented `probe:` or `monitor:` line, propose one in the Specter language defined at the top of src/spec.ts (steps: visit, click, type, remember number, expect number, expect text, expect visible, expect hidden, wait; monitors: `number X == sum Y`, `no errors in Ns`). Use selectors that exist in the app under test. Choose a probe for WHEN/THEN behavior and a monitor for "always" or "never" rules. If a criterion can't be checked from the page, say so instead of inventing a check. Run npm test afterwards; the default spec must still parse with one check per criterion.
